## Download Squeak

Choose the package that matches your computer under **Assets** below. Squeak is
a standalone app; Python and a GitHub account are not required.

- **M-series Mac:** `Squeak-macOS-Apple-Silicon.zip`
- **Older Intel Mac:** `Squeak-macOS-Intel.zip`
- **Windows 10 or 11:** `Squeak-Windows.zip`

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/karimh97/Squeak/blob/main/INSTALL.md)
for step-by-step instructions and first-launch security guidance.
